intro.description: The RoboCup Korea Association is a non-profit organization that hosts national and international robot events called RoboCup leagues for students studying robotics, and promotes project-based education.

stats.title: RoboCup Korea events held annually in Korea

aboutLeague.title: Main activities & goals of RoboCup Korea Leagues
aboutLeague.description: RoboCup Korea leagues provide opportunities for participants to apply their skills in real environments and develop collaboration and problem-solving skills through regular robot and AI competitions held annually.

items.creativity: Develop creative algorithms for problem solving
items.international: Opportunity to join the international RoboCup

sponsor.description1: The RoboCup Korea Association is a non-profit organization that has been operating RoboCup competitions for over 10 years since 2013.
sponsor.description2: All sponsorship funds are used for various purposes to foster young talents in robotics and promote AI and robotics education.
